Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciated the clear context on ingestion volume and the latency targets your team is tracking. Quick recap (so we're aligned):

- Success criteria: p95 generation latency < 600ms, predictable unit cost, and an easy ops handoff
- Risks called out: data residency for EU customers, and an ops owner for rollout

Next step: we'd love to run a short product briefing (30 minutes) focused on architecture fit + deployment options (hosted vs dedicated). Can you pick two time brackets that work for your team next week? We typically book a 30-min compact briefing and invite one technical and one ops stakeholder. A few options in PT: 

- Wed Jun 3, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Jun 4, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri Jun 5, 09:00–09:30 PT

Please reply with your preferred two brackets (or propose alternatives) and who from your side should join (engineering lead + ops/security rep ideally). I attached a brief agenda so folks know what to expect.

Attachments: briefing-agenda.pdf (1 page — walk-through + prep questions)

Thanks — I can hold the slots but will finalize once you confirm.
